content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant exists anywhere in the document. Searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce … to leave", "personnel/staff/recruit" returned nothing; the only restrictive covenants are the Section 6 exclusivity provisions (project participation and brand use), and the only employee references are the confidentiality carve-out (p0051) and the no-joint-venture clause (p0061). The integration clause confirms no other agreement imposes such covenants.

input.quote: This Agreement is the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, superseding any prior agreements and communications (both written and oral) regarding such subject matter.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant binding the Company (or HDI). Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce to leave", and "personnel/staff/recruit" returned no hits, and a full read of every section confirms it: the only restrictive covenants are the Section 6 exclusivity terms (p0037 project/brand exclusivity; p0042 HDI's two-year post-term restraint on similar projects), which concern competing projects and brand use rather than personnel. The only employee references are the confidentiality carve-out (p0051) and the no-joint-venture clause (p0061, "neither Party is the other's agent, partner, employee or representative"), neither of which restricts recruiting or hiring. The integration clause (p0069) makes this Agreement the complete and exclusive agreement on the subject matter, so no external non-solicit is imported. This meets our preferred position — no non-solicitation restriction on the Customer — so nothing to redline. (Separately, the Section 6 exclusivity and post-term restraint are matters for the exclusivity rule, not this one.)
